desc: Implement Landau-Vishkin/Myers furthest-reaching diagonal greedy (insert/delete/substitute) with rolling-hash binary-search snake for LCP
Add early reject when |n-m| > K and handle "0 operations" (initial lcp) case
Produce final production solver reading K, S, T from stdin and printing Yes/No; remove out-of-bounds stress harness
Verify all 3 provided samples via stdin (3/abc/awtf→Yes, 2/abc/awtf→No, 17/twothousandtwentyfour/happynewyear→Yes)
Stress test the recurrence against an O(nm) edit-distance oracle on small/random inputs
Edge coverage: equal strings, |len diff| = K, single substitution/deletion/insertion, reverse swap, length-1 strings
Performance validated: O(|S|+|T|+K^2 log L) fits within limits for lengths up to 5*10^5 and K≤20
